catalog.liveVersion: none - rotating feed, no snapshot identifier
catalog.method: GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/barry-far/V2ray-config/main/All_Configs_Sub.txt with User-Agent: DGMTunnel/1.5, 15 s timeouts, no redirects. Plain text, no encryption. App parses the first 500 profiles, filters (no SSH, no proxy), dedupes by protocol:server:port:uuid, takes the first 40. Result has no download APIs, only decoded data.
catalog.notes: ROTATING feed: a later re-fetch returns a different 40 (the app's own behaviour, not an error). Live re-run 2026-11-28 11:12 UTC reproduced the 10:05 snapshot exactly (identical 40 profiles, same 8,880 lines / 500 parsed / 57 rejected). No catalog version number by design. Precedent: Sentinel Tunnel (CAT 102) is also a public rotating feed served as a card. File/link decoding (darktunnel://, dgmtunnel://, vless/vmess/trojan/ss/ssh, DGMTUNNEL_SHARE v2) is delivered in dgm_tunnel.py but NOT wired in this catalog-only delivery (engine.py / text_bridge.py / registry untouched). File/text routes (dgmtunnel://, darktunnel://, .eyj/.dgm) are wired by CAT 103 as well.

dependencies: Python >=3.10; standard library only (PyCryptodome only for sealed DGMTUNNEL_SHARE v2 shares)

files.method: Same module decodes links/files (vless/vmess/trojan/ss/ssh, darktunnel://, dgmtunnel://, JSON profiles, DGMTUNNEL_SHARE v2 sealed shares with --share-password). .eyj/.dgm hold the raw DGMTUNNEL_SHARE v2 envelope JSON (same bytes, only the extension changes); .json/.txt are generic and deliberately NOT registered. No own file extension beyond .eyj/.dgm; the app does not use .sks.

name: DGM Tunnel

texts.note: Own schemes darktunnel:// and dgmtunnel:// (plus standard vless/vmess/trojan/ss/ssh) wired via text_bridge.py and the C8 file_decoder adapter (DGMTUNNEL_SHARE v2, with and without password, via the existing password flow).
